learning_outcomes.text: Students know techniques and tools to elicit and manage project requirements.
Students understand the classical and agile approach.
Students can assess the challenges at different project times and the information needs of the involved stakeholders, and utilize the respective advantages of the different methods.

syllabus_topics: Success factors of successful Requirements Engineering (Quality criteria)

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is an oral examination (individual examination) or a written exam.
